basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old true crime enthusiast living in Philadelphia. When I'm not delving into unsolved mysteries or reading about notorious cases, I'm supporting my local hockey team, the Flyers. I work as a freelance writer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my interests in both literature and sports. I'm single and enjoy my evenings with a good podcast or a gripping crime novel. My typical online hours are late evenings as I wind down from the day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've developed a strong interest in true crime through years of watching documentaries, listening to podcasts, and reading books on the subject. My background in journalism contributes to my research skills and attention to detail when exploring new cases.
